spans.s:
1 N. of a country; the
स्कदंपुराण thus describes its
position: --वंगदेशं समारभ्य भुवनेशांतगः
शिवे । गौडदेशः समाख्यातः
सर्वविद्याविशारदः ॥
--2 A particular
subdivision of Brāhmaṇas.
--डाः (pl.)
The inhabitants of Gauḍa.
--डी
1
Spirit distilled from molasses;
गौडी पैष्टी च माध्वी च विज्ञेया त्रिविधा सुरा

.
--2 One of the Rāgiṇīs.
--3 (In rhet.) One of the Rītis or
Vṛttis or styles of poetic
composition: S. D. mentions four Rītis,
while K. P. only three, गौडी being
another name for परुषा वृत्ति;
ओजःप्रकाशकैस्तैः (वर्णैः) तु परुषा (i. e.
गौडी) K.

^1; ओजःप्रकाशकैर्वर्णैर्बंध
आडंबरः पुनः समासबहुला गौडी
S.

.
--डं Sweetmeats.
[1] Correction submitted by User AndhraBharati on 20210829. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/AP90/issues/24#issuecomment-907699250. note: ls reference corrected.

गौडिक a. Relating to molasses.
--कः Sugar-cane.
--कं Rum.

गौड or पुंड्र Northern Bengal, (Puṇḍra originally
signifying the land of the ‘Pooree’ cane.)
